title: The low-temperature Sherrington–Kirkpatrick fluctuation law

result.label: The low-temperature Sherrington–Kirkpatrick fluctuation law
result.statement: For every fixed inverse temperature β > 1, determines the fluctuation scale and limiting law of the zero-field Gaussian Sherrington–Kirkpatrick log partition function. Its variance is asymptotic to c n^ 1/3 , with c 0, confirming the predicted n 1/6 standard-deviation scale. Exact centering and standardization give full-sequence convergence to a uniquely characterized nondegenerate law.
